steps.fms: const r = fps.active.availableOriginRunways.map((x) => x.ident).sort(); await fps.setOriginRunway(r[0]);
const d = [...fps.active.availableDepartures].sort((a, b) => a.ident.localeCompare(b.ident)); if (d.length) await fps.setDepartureProcedure(d[0].databaseId);
const a = [...fps.active.availableArrivals].sort((x, y) => x.ident.localeCompare(y.ident)); if (a.length) await fps.setArrival(a[0].databaseId);
const p = [...fps.active.availableApproaches].sort((x, y) => x.ident.localeCompare(y.ident)); if (p.length) await fps.setApproach(p[0].databaseId);
